instruction: Enable night light mode to reduce blue light in the evening.

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling the night light feature in system settings. This is infeasible because checking whether night light is enabled requires accessing GNOME settings daemon state or dconf database values that vary across desktop environments and cannot be reliably validated.
